🇺🇸🇷🇺🇨🇳🇮🇷 The Iran war is being held in place deliberately right now. And Thursday's summit could explain why.

Brandon Weichert, fresh off an interview with Tucker Carlson, joins me to help unpack this week's news.

The big story is Shenzhen: Trump, Putin, and Xi meet this week. Brandon has been pushing for exactly this since 2017: a Big Three moment, like Stalin, Churchill, and FDR rewriting the postwar world. 

Russia has the resources, China the mass production, America the R&D. Trump is in a different mindset now, post-election loss, with the Iran war going nowhere. 

Putin and Xi aren’t going to corner him. They’re going to make him an offer.

But does somebody want to disrupt that? 

The banking outages hitting Wells Fargo, JPMorgan, and BofA today are the third infrastructure disruption in a week, after the FAA ground stop and Microsoft outage. What are the chances all of this is simply random?

Meanwhile, the Houthis are now closer to Aden than at any point since 2015. When it falls, they’ll pivot north into the Saudi mountains. 

Houthi spiritual leaders are already talking about Mecca and Medina. If they move in that direction, it could trigger a Sunni-Shia holy war across the entire region.

Michael Richards reportedly made $600,000 an episode playing Kramer on Seinfeld. Then in 2006, he screamed racial slurs at Black audience members during a comedy club set, and his career ended overnight.

In the video below, he reveals what he believes was behind it, and he can barely get the words out.

In the late '80s, Richards learned something about his own birth: he was conceived when his mother was raped.

He says the feeling of being unwanted stayed with him for decades. An inferiority complex followed him into his career.

That night in 2006, a heckler set him off, and it all came out in the worst way possible. The video exploded online. He walked away from Hollywood and disappeared for almost 20 years.

"I don't want any pity," he says, fighting back tears. "I canceled myself."

Jerry Seinfeld still asks him when he's coming back.

Should a man be defined by his worst moment forever, or does he deserve a second chance?

"The US [should] support the effort in Ukraine, to defend themselves and their people against Russia's aggression."

We need peace between Russia and Ukraine. President Trump wants the WAR to END 🙏🏻

Ranting about how aggressive Russia is doesn't accomplish anything. The meat grinder has to end

Strike a deal, Zelensky!
